# Two template sets may each define a template of the same name. Both
# definitions are reported: collapsing them by name alone would attribute
# one set's definition to the other set's call.
#
# The two calls are listed in source order, and each name is reported
# once per definition site rather than once per call.

check-templates -definitions
cmpenv stdout want.txt
! stderr .

-- want.txt --
$WORK/main.go:9:56+16	"row"	$WORK/main.go:9:77+7	$WORK/main.go:9:65+5
$WORK/main.go:10:58+16	"row"	$WORK/main.go:10:80+7	$WORK/main.go:10:67+5
-- go.mod --
module example.com/app

go 1.25.0
-- main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"html/template"
	"net/http"
)

var admin = template.Must(template.New("admin").Parse(`{{define "row"}}ADMIN{{end}}`))
var public = template.Must(template.New("public").Parse(`{{define "row"}}PUBLIC{{end}}`))

type Page struct {
	Title string
}

func handleAdmin(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	_ = admin.ExecuteTemplate(w, "row", Page{Title: "Home"})
}

func handlePublic(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	_ = public.ExecuteTemplate(w, "row", Page{Title: "Home"})
}

var _ = fmt.Sprint
